mapper.select: SELECT GOV_PROJECT_CODE, GOV_PROJECT_NAME, GOV_PROJECT_DATE, GOV_PROJECT_INFO, TARGET_CONDITION FROM GOV_SUPPORT_POLICY ORDER BY GOV_PROJECT_DATE
SELECT e.EXAM_SESSION, e.EXAM_DATE, e.CERT_CODE, c.CERT_NAME, c.CERT_INFO FROM CERT_EXAM e JOIN CERT c ON e.CERT_CODE = c.CERT_CODE ORDER BY e.EXAM_DATE
SELECT JOB_POSTING_CODE, JOB_POSTING_NAME, JOB_POSTING_DATE, RECRUITMENT_INFO FROM RECRUITMENT ORDER BY JOB_POSTING_DATE

SELECT 'POLICY' AS allpcj, GOV_PROJECT_CODE AS CODE, GOV_PROJECT_NAME AS TITLE, GOV_PROJECT_DATE AS START_DATE, GOV_PROJECT_INFO AS INFO FROM GOV_SUPPORT_POLICY
UNION ALL
SELECT 'CERT', CONCAT(e.CERT_CODE, '-', e.EXAM_SESSION), CONCAT(c.CERT_NAME, ' ', e.EXAM_SESSION), e.EXAM_DATE, c.CERT_INFO FROM CERT_EXAM e JOIN CERT c ON e.CERT_CODE = c.CERT_CODE
UNION ALL
SELECT 'JOB', JOB_POSTING_CODE, JOB_POSTING_NAME, JOB_POSTING_DATE, RECRUITMENT_INFO FROM RECRUITMENT
ORDER BY START_DATE
